subject: PhD advisor and institution sought for bear mapping project PhD student

messages.subject: PhD advisor and institution sought for bear mapping project PhD student
parts:
Dear colleagues,

here's perhaps a slightly unusual "job offer". The IUCN Bear Specialist Group is looking for a PhD supervisor and an institution for a PhD student (to be chosen later) who should produce bear species distribution maps for Asia. Please see the attachments, and note that deadline is 31 March.

Best regards --- Marc
